name: thingctx
description: Drive any agent against any W3C WoT Thing from its description. The agent never holds your keys; you gate what it is allowed to do.

tools.name: search_things
tools.description: Find Things by capability, name, or keyword

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Read a Thing's full interface: actions, properties, events

tools.name: invoke_action
tools.description: Run an action a Thing declares

tools.name: read_property
tools.description: Read a property a Thing declares

tools.name: write_property
tools.description: Write a property a Thing declares

tools.name: start_subscription
tools.description: Start collecting an event a Thing declares

tools.name: read_subscription
tools.description: Read events collected by a subscription

tools.name: approve
tools.description: Run an action parked awaiting the user's confirmation

tds.title: Things to serve
tds.description: A TD Directory URL, a folder of Thing Descriptions, or a TD file. Defaults to the curated thingctx registry.

policy.title: What can the agent do?
policy.description: read-only = reads, subscriptions, and safe (no-change) actions; full = everything the Things allow. Denied operations are refused before any request leaves.

approve_when.title: When should the agent ask you before acting?
approve_when.description: declared = only actions marked risky; destructive = any write or non-idempotent action; all = everything; never = do not ask.

fs_root.title: Filesystem sandbox (optional)
fs_root.description: Directory the filesystem Thing may touch. Leave empty to refuse all filesystem calls.
